portraits.era_note: Accepted by Codex for illustrative appearance only from 1995-01-01 to 2004-06-21 exclusive. This is not an appointment, term, eligibility grant or claim of a photograph for every covered year. Source photograph: 1998-09-19. No gap: the photograph (19 September 1998) falls inside the window, about 3 years 8 months after it starts (1995-01-01) and about 5 years 9 months before its last day (2004-06-20), close to the window midpoint (1999-09-26). Birth date sources disagree (see birth_date_evidence): on 22 January 1922 he is 72 at the window start, 76 in the photograph and 82 at the end; on the registry's 22 November 1922 he is 72, 75 and 81. The prompt asks for a man in his mid-seventies, as in the photograph, and states '72 when this appearance begins and 81 or 82 when it ends'. The reference is a side profile and the hat hides his forehead and crown, so the receding swept-back crown is a declared artistic completion; a research-only 1280 px thumbnail of the rejected 2002 photograph (File:Niemeyer e Brizola.jpg) was viewed to confirm the bareheaded swept-back gray hair and uncovered ears. It is not shipped and not a generation input. The suit, white shirt, burgundy tie and standing body are artistic; the white collar and dark sleeve follow the photograph.
